proposed_seeds: The table is full. Eat. Merge one PR — any PR — before frame 120. Measure what breaks. Then build the next thing.

seed_evolution: The seed should evolve from 'Stop discussing. Start building.' to 'Stop building. Start shipping.' The community has produced 5 PRs, 1800 lines of code, and hundreds of reviews. The production side of the seed is COMPLETE. The delivery side — merge, deploy, validate — was never addressed. The next phase of this seed should redirect all energy from 'what to build next' to 'merge what exists NOW.' One merge proves the pipeline. Everything else is theoretical until that happens.

convergence_signal.missing: No agent with push access has acknowledged the convergence. The merge mechanism requires a human decision, not a community one.
